name: qa_names
title: OS-NAMES: NAME for a track (Mixer, Shift + F1), a pattern (Song, Shift + F6) and the project (File, Shift + F6) on the on-screen keyboard; the names drawn on the Pattern screen, the Song order and the File header; SAVE AS prefilled from the title; undo takes the three names back. Changes the open project (undone by the steps; do not save it)

steps.say: OS-NAMES, rows QA-MIX-010..012, QA-SNG-010/011, QA-FIL-060..062 and QA-PAT-200 of docs/qa/catalogue. Needs the t-v16 project open, the transport stopped and a writable card (SAVE AS opens its keyboard only on a writable card)

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)

steps.say: QA-MIX-010 / 011: Mixer, MIXER page, the cursor on T1. Shift + F1 opens the keyboard titled TRACK NAME over T1's name, selected; typing over the selection (pads l e a d) and F1 (OK) name the track

steps.note: QA-MIX-010: TRACK NAME, keys TYPE CAPS CANCEL OK (the name differs from the simulator's)
F1 is OK: it accepts the name

steps.say: QA-MIX-012: a bus is not a track. The cursor goes past the tracks to IN; Shift + F1 says TRACKS ONLY and no keyboard opens

steps.note: QA-MIX-012: the strip says TRACKS ONLY

steps.say: QA-SNG-010 / 011: Song. Shift + F6 opens PATTERN NAME over the pattern of the slot under the cursor; pads i n t r o and F1 (OK) name it; the order row carries the name

steps.note: F1 is OK: it accepts the name
QA-SNG-011: the order row and the PAT field of the strip say intro

steps.say: QA-PAT-200: the Pattern screen draws the names: the header of track 1 reads 01 lead and the info line P<nn> intro after the track

steps.note: QA-PAT-200: 01 lead in the first header; the info line reads track 1 P.. intro

steps.say: QA-FIL-060 / 062: File, PROJECTS page. Shift + F6 opens PROJECT NAME over the project's title; pads d e m o and F1 (OK) set it (the folder on the card is not renamed); the header names the project

steps.note: QA-FIL-060: PROJECT NAME over the project's title (the t-v16 title, selected)
F1 is OK: it accepts the name
QA-FIL-062: the header reads PROJECT demo at the right, before OPEN

steps.say: QA-FIL-061: SAVE AS (F5) of a project that came from a folder opens with the automatic Track nn; of a new or imported project it opens with the title. t-v16 was opened from a folder: the keyboard reads Track nn. NEW (F3, then F3 again for the changes) and F5 shows the title instead (the new project has none: Track nn again; name it first with Shift + F6)

steps.note: QA-FIL-061: SAVE AS over a project with a folder: Track nn (a project with no folder and the title demo reads demo)

steps.say: Undo takes the three names back: on Pattern, F8 undoes the project title, the pattern's name and the track's name, one unit each

steps.note: the header of track 1 reads its old name again and the info line has no pattern name
the File header no longer says PROJECT demo (the folder's name if the project has no title)
